description: This file contains refund-related business logic, including a data class for refund request results and a function to process refund requests based on an order reference code.

classes.name: RefundRequestResult
classes.description: Result object indicating success or failure of a refund request, with an optional reference to the associated order.

methods.name: RefundRequestResult request_refund(*, ref_code: str, message: str, email: str)
methods.description: Handles the process of recording a refund request for an order by ref_code, updating the order, creating a refund record, and returning the result.

ctags.name: request_refund
ctags.pattern: /^def request_refund(*, ref_code: str, message: str, email: str) -> RefundRequestResult:$/
ctags.signature: (*, ref_code: str, message: str, email: str)
